cell_line.evidence: FFPE cytospin material from Hep293TT cells replicating a full-length HEV genome HEV or the green fluorescent protein were used as positive and negative controls.

cell_type.evidence: To perform mass spectrometry analysis of glomerular extracts from Patient 1, glomeruli stained for HEV ORF2 protein (1E6 antibody) were dissected using the ArcturusXT™ LCM System (Thermo Scientific).
One cap containing interstitial tissue was also prepared per sample type (kidney from Patient 1 and the non-HEV infected patient, 2 caps in total).

material_type.evidence: Tissue samples of the allograft kidney from Patient 1 were collected at autopsy and were fixed in 2.5% buffered glutaraldehyde for at least 12 h, post-fixed for 2 h in 1% osmium tetroxide, dehydrated in a series of graded ethanol solutions and propylene oxide and embedded in epoxy resin 48 h at 60 °C.

sample_source.evidence: In situ hybridization for HEV RNA was performed as described in ref.  using a commercially available probe designated V-HEV, targeting nucleotides 19-7257 of HEV-1 to -4 (Advanced Cell Diagnostics, #468111), a human negative (Dap-B) and a positive control (PPIB) –probes (Advanced Cell Diagnostics, #310043 and #313901 respectively).
